title: 第9章 灵珍坊风波第10章 我可以救你
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“父亲，你的修为，卡在地境中期，应该快有七年了吧。”
叶云飞突然问道。
“不错。”
叶天鹏一愣，答道。
“如果有一颗三品玄元丹相助，你应该可以一举突破到地境后期了吧。”
叶云飞说道。
“确实是这样。
只不过，购买一颗三品玄元丹，最起码需要一万块灵晶石。
而且，只有帝国皇城的那些炼丹大师，才有能力炼制。
所以，往往有价无市，就算有钱，也很难买得到。
好了，飞儿，父亲的修炼，你就不用担心了，我自有分数。”
叶天鹏苦笑了一下，说道。
然后，他抬步离去。
他是一族之主，族务繁忙。
“哦？
区区三品玄元丹，垃圾之极，居然也值一万块灵晶石？
看来，在大秦帝国，灵丹还是挺值钱的嘛。”
叶云飞有点意外。
要知道，上一辈子，叶云飞不但是一个天帝，还被称为丹尊！
就连帝丹也炼制过不少！

鸿蒙界之中，不知道有多少强者，曾经排着队，低声下气，求叶云飞帮忙炼丹。
三品灵丹，对叶云飞的炼丹水平来说，简直是垃圾到了极点。
叶天鹏离去之后，叶云飞进入房间之中，捣鼓了片刻，然后走出房间。
“小月，我要出去一趟。”
叶云飞向小月交待了一声，抬步向院子外走去。
圆月城的西边，有一条着名的灵药一条街。
叶云飞走进灵药一条街，径直朝着这条街中，规模最大，实力最雄厚的灵珍坊走去。
灵珍坊，是圆月城中最大的一间灵药店铺。
据说，灵珍坊遍布整个大秦帝国，赫赫有名。
圆月城的灵珍坊，只不过是其中一间分店。
走进灵珍坊，里面是一个大厅，面积很大，充斥着灵药和丹药的香味。
有许多顾客，正在选购，十分热闹。
大厅之中，靠近后门的位置，有一个柜台，柜台后面，坐着一个黄袍中年男子，脸色傲然，看在看着一本小册子，根本就不理会大厅中的其他人。
“嗯，这个，应该就是灵珍坊的炼丹师了。”
叶云飞直接朝那个炼丹师走去。
灵珍坊是一间实力雄厚的灵药店铺，有一个炼丹师坐镇，并不新奇。
“客官，请问，有什么可以帮忙的吗。”
一个店小二冲了上来，挡住了叶云飞的去路。
“让开。”
叶云飞淡淡说道，身形一动，已经是鬼魅一般，绕过店小二，来到了那个炼丹师所在的柜台之前。

content_en:
"Father, your cultivation has been stuck in the middle stage of the Earth Realm for almost seven years."
Ye Yunfei suddenly asked.
"Not bad."
Ye Tianpeng was stunned and replied.
"If you have a third-grade Xuanyuan Pill to help you, you should be able to break through to the late stage of the Earth Realm in one fell swoop."
Ye Yunfei said.
"That's true.
However, to purchase a third-grade Xuanyuan Dan, you need at least 10,000 spiritual crystals.
Moreover, only those alchemy masters in the imperial city have the ability to refine it.
Therefore, there is often a price but no market, and even if you have money, it is difficult to buy it.
Okay, Fei'er, you don't have to worry about my father's cultivation, I have my own score. "
Ye Tianpeng smiled bitterly and said.
Then, he walked away.
He is the head of the clan and is busy with family affairs.
"Oh?
A mere third-grade Xuanyuan Dan, which is extremely rubbish, is actually worth ten thousand spiritual crystals?
It seems that in the Great Qin Empire, spiritual elixirs are quite valuable. "
Ye Yunfei was a little surprised.
You know, in his previous life, Ye Yunfei was not only a Heavenly Emperor, he was also called Alchemist!
Even Emperor Dan has been refined a lot!
In the Hongmeng Realm, countless powerful people once lined up and begged Ye Yunfei for help in refining elixirs.
The third-grade elixir was simply rubbish to the extreme level of Ye Yunfei's alchemy level.
After Ye Tianpeng left, Ye Yunfei entered the room, tinkered for a while, and then walked out of the room.
"Xiaoyue, I want to go out."
Ye Yunfei confessed to Xiaoyue and walked out of the yard.
To the west of Yuanyue City, there is a famous elixir street.
Ye Yunfei walked into the elixir street and walked straight towards the largest and most powerful Lingzhenfang in this street.
Lingzhenfang is the largest elixir shop in Yuanyue City.
It is said that Lingzhenfang is spread throughout the Qin Empire and is famous.
Lingzhenfang in Yuanyue City is just one of the branches.
Walking into Lingzhenfang, there is a large hall inside, filled with the fragrance of elixirs and elixirs.
There are many customers shopping, which is very lively.
In the hall, near the back door, there was a counter. Behind the counter, there was a middle-aged man in yellow robe sitting with an arrogant face. He was looking at a pamphlet and ignored the other people in the hall.
"Well, this should be the alchemist from Lingzhenfang."
Ye Yunfei walked directly towards the alchemist.
Lingzhenfang is a powerful elixir shop, and it is not unusual to have an alchemist in charge.
"Sir, may I help you in any way?"
A waiter rushed up and blocked Ye Yunfei's way.
"Get out of the way."
Ye Yunfei said lightly, and with a movement of his body, he looked like a ghost, bypassing the waiter, and came to the counter where the alchemist was.
